rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kaliya, the venomous thousand-hooded naga in the Yamuna.
ANATOMY: ONE enormous intertwined serpent body with ONE THOUSAND cobra hoods, each hood carrying its own serpent head; no limbs, no wings [kaliya-c01, kaliya-c07]. The hoods form a vast dense mass, not seven or nine heads: precisely FIFTY complete clearly separated rows of EXACTLY TWENTY tiny visible narrow cobra hoods per row, all 1000 hoods inside the image, each spreading backward above the river, with the ALL ranks uniformly very small, nearest ranks small enough for all 1000 hoods to fit and be counted and the distant ranks smaller but individually separated. The thousand-headed naga itself is the subject.
MOMENT: rear the entire multitude of hoods upward from boiling poison water, nearest mouths open toward the viewer, coils churning the river.
POWER: river water visibly boils and bubbles around the many serpent coils from its poison [kaliya-c02]; no neon or glowing venom.
SCALE & CAMERA: high near-overhead compressed perspective looking at the complete rectangular fan of 1000 individual cobra hoods, monumental naga hood mass fills nearly the entire frame with very little empty sky; prioritize dense anatomically separated thousand-hood multitude.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low amber sunset rim-light behind dark hoods, deep brown shadows, natural boiling spray and steam.
SURFACE: wet black-brown snake scales, translucent water droplets, earthy poisoned river surface.
SETTING: Yamuna at Vrindavan, distant dark riverbank [kaliya-c01].
MOOD: overwhelming awe and danger, respectful Hindu narrative illustration, never comic, cute or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
